content:
Here is the passage translated into English:

Then in turn the lord of men, Agamemnon, addressed him:

"Son of Laertes, I rejoice to hear your words, for you have gone through everything and set it forth in due measure. These things I am willing to swear to, and my heart bids me do so, nor will I swear falsely before the god. But let Achilles wait here for a while, eager though he be for battle; and let all the rest of you remain gathered together, until the gifts come from my tent and we cut faithful oaths. And to you yourself I give this charge and command: choose out the best young men among the Achaeans and bring the gifts from my ship — all that we pledged yesterday to give to Achilles — and bring the women as well. And let Talthybius quickly make ready a boar for me throughout the broad camp of the Achaeans, to sacrifice to Zeus and to Helios."
